{{Quote|The RSF officer is named Turon Adala. Use the standard recognition code ''Tibanna gas''.|Pooja Naberrie|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Turon Adala''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with locating Adala and escorting him back to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Although the spacer was attacked by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Staff Sergeant/Legends|staff sergeant]], Naberrie's mission was completed.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Turon Adala was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Players who performed a series of [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] for [[W:c:swg:Pooja Naberrie|Pooja Naberrie]] had to locate Adala and escort him safely back to [[W:c:swg:Dee'ja Peak|Dee'ja Peak]]. However, due to a bug, many of the NPCs in Naberrie's quests were not properly sequenced. For instance, in the quest to escort Adala, players actually encountered an individual known as [[Lim Paddu]], who was supposed to appear in the following quest. The character model for Turon Adala likewise erroneously spawned for Naberrie's third quest, in which the player was supposed to encounter an individual named [[Jumis]]. Nevertheless, it was possible for the player to complete the mission and advance to the next quest. This article assumes that the content of Naberrie's quest dialogue is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, and that Adala, not Lim Paddu, actually appeared during her fourth quest.<ref name="AED" />

Because Turon Adala spawned under the generic "naboo_police" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible depictions. He could either appear as a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|haired]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Human female, or as a brown haired, brown eyed Human male. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Adala as male, this article assumes that the Human male depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. Examining the NPC also revealed his name to be '''Turon Idala'''. This article assumes "Adala" to be the correct surname, as it was consistently used in the quest dialogue.<ref name="AED" /> The questline that involved Adala was eventually removed from the game when Pooja Naberrie was relocated to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] as part of the newly introduced [[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]], released as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
